skills.name: Vendor describe
skills.description: The agent profile: vendor, product lines, actions, agent version, data date.

skills.name: Catalog search
skills.description: Lenovo items by words, platform, AI Express and region.

skills.name: Sizing calc
skills.description: GPU memory, GPUs and the AI Express tier for a workload. Code only.

skills.name: Reference match
skills.description: Validated reference configurations; the tier, or the requirement from which the tier is found.

skills.name: Rules check
skills.description: Check BOM lines of one server against Lenovo rules; each violation has its BOM lines and a fix, and the nearest valid configuration.

skills.name: Price get
skills.description: List prices with date and source.

skills.name: Assets get
skills.description: Product photos as links, with source and licence.

skills.name: Design propose
skills.description: A full part of the solution: tier, servers, BOM by role, rules check with fixes, interfaces, layers, gaps and caveats; the BOM as an Excel link. 15-60 s.

skills.name: Design change
skills.description: Apply one change to a part; returns the new part and the difference. A change that breaks a hard rule is refused with the nearest valid configuration.

skills.name: Design figure
skills.description: Rack elevation of a part as an SVG link, and the layered description.

skills.name: Advice explain
skills.description: Answer from the Lenovo guides, with quotes and sources.
examples: {"skill": "advice_explain", "request": {"question": "Why Medium and not Large for 400 people?"}}

skills.name: Bom from spec
skills.description: A full BOM from the requirements of an RFP: servers configured to the parts asked, storage by usable capacity, switches, service, rack and power, ports; the deviations from the RFP and the questions, each with the value taken. A missing fact is an assumption. 5-30 s.
